source_material_or_draft: The reading says that replacing all delivery trucks with autonomous drones will save energy. The professor disagrees. She says drones use a lot of battery to stay in the air and can only carry one package at a time.

S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]：Specifically, she explains that when [Real-World Condition], [Mechanism B occurs instead], which [Negates the Claimed Benefit].

消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）

S4 [一句话总结效果 Operational Effect]：Whenever two channels fall out of phase, this term suppresses their attention weight automatically.

communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在图表或实验结果段中，专门挑出违背总体规律的 1–2 个异常点（Outliers）或局部反常尖峰进行精准描述与成因剖析。

S3 [底层物理/统计成因剖析 Root Cause Analysis]：Closer inspection indicates that this anomaly stems from [Specific Structural/External Factor] rather than random variance.
S4 [方法论启示 Methodological Implication]：Accounting for such localized departures is critical when calibrating [Downstream Model/Policy].

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：Academic_Speech 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT07 (顶会 5 分钟 Oral 演讲完整逐字稿：非平稳时间序列预测（含开场 Hook、图表引导、公式直觉与 Q&A）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP41 -> BP03 -> BP04`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: The reading says that replacing all delivery trucks with autonomous drones will save energy. The professor disagrees. She says drones use a lot of battery to stay in the air and can only carry one package at a time.
structural_constraints: S1 [正方/阅读论点概括 Reading Claim & Rationale]：The reading passage contends that [Claim A], arguing that [Reading's Supporting Mechanism].
S2 [反方/听力直接反驳 Lecture Direct Refutation]：The lecturer directly challenges this assertion by pointing out that [Core Flaw / Neglected Factor in Reading's Premise].
S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]：Specifically, she explains that when [Real-World Condition], [Mechanism B occurs instead], which [Negates the Claimed Benefit].
S4 [结论锁定 Refutation Closure]：Consequently, rather than achieving [Reading's Goal], the proposed measure actually exacerbates [Negative Outcome].
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: IELTS Task 1 特例段 / 论文实验反常现象（Anomalous Observation）剖析段
domain_context: 基于扩散/流匹配的缺失时序插补与生成
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在图表或实验结果段中，专门挑出违背总体规律的 1–2 个异常点（Outliers）或局部反常尖峰进行精准描述与成因剖析。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP32` 与全文样板 `FT07` 的后半部分（`BP43 -> BP42 -> BP44`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: In recent years, many works studied time series foundation models. TimeGPT trained a transformer on large data. Moment used masked pre-training. Chronos quantized time series into tokens. Lag-Llama used lag features. However, our model is different from them.
structural_constraints: S1 [总体规律背景下的特例锚定 Outlier Identification]：Although [General Trend holds across most groups/steps], a notable departure from this pattern occurs in [Specific Point/Group].
S2 [反常幅度量化 Quantitative Deviation]：Whereas peer categories cluster tightly within $[A, B]$, [Outlier Entity] spikes/drops to [Extreme Value], deviating by more than [X%] from the group median.
S3 [底层物理/统计成因剖析 Root Cause Analysis]：Closer inspection indicates that this anomaly stems from [Specific Structural/External Factor] rather than random variance.
S4 [方法论启示 Methodological Implication]：Accounting for such localized departures is critical when calibrating [Downstream Model/Policy].
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
